paper_title: Search for Axion-Like Particles produced in $e^+e^-$ collisions at Belle II
notes: Paper presents direct search for e+e- → γa, a → γγ at Belle II. Abstract states '95% confidence level upper limits on the coupling strength g_agamma of ALPs to photons at the level of 10^-3 GeV^-1'. The limits are the most restrictive for 0.2 < m_a < 1 GeV/c^2. Data points extracted from Figure 5 (exclusion plot) showing observed 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma vs ALP mass m_a. The coupling values are read from the plot with typical uncertainty of ±10-15% due to plot resolution. Transition from M^2_gamma-gamma to M^2_recoil analysis occurs at m_a = 6.85 GeV/c^2. No evidence for ALPs found; largest local significance is 2.8σ near m_a = 0.477 GeV/c^2. | selector: text (sole candidate)
